story.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Delhi Against Modi Government's Voter Roll Changes
story.summary: Tens of thousands of protesters gathered in Delhi, led by the Congress party, to express their anger over the removal of 130 million names from India's voter roll. The demonstration featured participants from across the country, marked by chants and drums, reflecting widespread discontent with the Modi administration's electoral policies.

timeline_highlights.title: France Faces Aftermath of Violent Protests with Widespread Damage and Arrests
timeline_highlights.summary: France is dealing with significant damage following violent protests that erupted on Saturday, October 17. The demonstrations, which were initially against rising living costs and poor school conditions, escalated into clashes with police, resulting in widespread looting and destruction across multiple cities. Authorities reported approximately 1,800 arrests nationwide, with significant incidents including a historic town hall being set ablaze.
key_facts: Protests occurred on October 17, 2026.
Approximately 1,800 people were arrested nationwide.
A historic town hall was set on fire.
Protests were against rising living costs and poor school conditions.

timeline_highlights.title: Violent Protests Erupt in Germany Amid Cost-of-Living Demands
timeline_highlights.summary: Protests led by Gen Z activists across Germany turned violent, with significant unrest reported in cities including Frankfurt, Berlin, and Hamburg. Rioters looted shops and set fires to barricades, demanding lower living costs and improved education. The unrest coincided with similar protests in France, highlighting widespread discontent among young people in Europe.

timeline_highlights.summary: Student unions in France have announced that high school blockades will restart on Monday, following weeks of protests against rising prices and deteriorating learning conditions. The decision comes after President Emmanuel Macron's call for classes to resume, which students deemed insufficient in addressing the ongoing education crisis.

event_overview.title: About Protests in France
event_overview.subject: Protests in France
event_overview.summary: The protests in France are a nationwide social and political mobilization that grew from secondary-school students’ complaints about school conditions and broader anger over the cost of living. A major day of demonstrations on October 17, 2026 included authorized marches but was also marked in numerous cities by violence, looting and attacks on public buildings and security forces; authorities subsequently continued to permit some demonstrations while imposing local safety restrictions.

facts.label: Start and duration
facts.value: The movement was already under way before the nationwide mobilization of October 17, 2026, and remained active as of October 31, with further national protest days on October 24 and October 31; no end date had been announced.

facts.label: Core issues
facts.value: The French presidency described the movement as having roots in lycée student mobilization and in concerns about the high cost of living. Reporting on the October 17 action identified demands concerning school conditions alongside rising living costs.

facts.label: Geographic scope
facts.value: The protests were nationwide, with demonstrations and related disorder reported in Paris and numerous other French cities; the Interior Ministry described the October 17 violence as occurring in many cities across the national territory.

facts.label: Participants and character
facts.value: The mobilization brought together student activists, labor-union supporters and other groups. It included lawful demonstrations, while officials say separate mobile groups carried out attacks, theft and looting; the violence should not be treated as synonymous with all participants or all marches.

facts.label: Authorities and legal administration
facts.value: Public-order management is led nationally by the Interior Ministry and implemented locally by prefects. For later protest days, prefects were instructed to assess declared demonstrations and organizers’ security arrangements, and officials stated that demonstrations meeting safeguards could be authorized and escorted.

event_overview.scope_note: The selected Muninn timeline focuses on the immediate aftermath of the October 17 violence and political, cultural and policing developments from October 18-21; it does not encompass the movement’s earlier student organizing or all later demonstrations and official responses.

related_stories.title: France Launches Attempted Murder Investigation Following Protest Violence
related_stories.summary: An attempted murder investigation has been initiated by Paris prosecutors after petrol bombs were thrown at police during protests. The incident, which included footage of an officer on fire, has drawn significant public outrage. During the protests and Halloween night, France reported 779 arrests, a decrease compared to previous weekends.

related_stories.title: Haley Stevens Endorses Mike Rogers Following Withdrawal from El-Sayed Event
related_stories.summary: Haley Stevens has publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers for the Michigan Senate seat after being disinvited from an event by Abdul El-Sayed's campaign due to a dispute over an antisemitic advertisement. This endorsement marks a significant shift in the race, potentially impacting El-Sayed's campaign as polls tighten in the final days before the election.
